adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Linezolid binds 23S rRNA on the 50S subunit and blocks assembly of the functional 70S initiation complex, inhibiting translation before elongation.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Macrolides also bind 50S but inhibit elongation/translocation. Linezolid uniquely prevents formation of the functional 70S initiation complex; the distractors map to other translation inhibitors.
